| B02 First name | MARICEL | |

| B05 Street number and name | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your new U.S. home street address. |
| B06 Apartment number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter your apartment number if you have one. |
| B07 City or town | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the city or town where you live. |
| B08 State | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the state where you live. |
| B09 ZIP Code | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the ZIP Code for your home address. |
| B10 Date of birth | 09 AUG 1991 | Rewrite the passport date in month/day/year order, with two digits each for the month and day and four for the year. |
| B11 U.S. Social Security number | Leave blank in this draft | You don’t have an SSN yet. |
| B12 Email address | NEEDS-YOU | Your email address wasn’t provided. |
| B13 Telephone number | +65 8555 0143 | |
| B14 Citizenship or immigration status | Box 4, authorized to work until **09/30/2029** | Check box 4 and enter the work authorization expiration date. |
| B15 Foreign passport number and country of issuance | P4829173B | Use the foreign passport option. Add **Philippines** as the country of issuance in the same field. Leave the A-Number and I-94 alternatives blank. |
| B16 Employee signature | NEEDS-YOU | Sign the form yourself. |
| B17 Today’s date | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date you actually sign, in mm/dd/yyyy format. |

Fill any applicable `NEEDS-YOU` fields directly on your form. The excerpt says to complete and sign Section 1 after accepting the offer and by your first day of employment. If a preparer or translator assisted you, the excerpt says that person must complete the certification on page 3.
